finding.counterexample: A selecting NetworkPolicy using matchExpressions operator NotIn also selects a pod when that key is absent. The first collector implementation returned false for that case, so a real selecting broad-allow policy could be omitted from the claimed complete additive policy inventory.
finding.upstream_semantics: Kubernetes set-based NotIn selectors include resources that do not carry the key; matchLabels and matchExpressions requirements are ANDed.
finding.security_consequence: Omitting such a selecting NetworkPolicy can hide a broad allow path from the collector inventory and violates the fail-closed complete-policy-set contract.

repair.expected_behavior: The NotIn policy selects the ClayVerse pod even though security-zone is absent, then the empty egress rule is detected as an obvious broad allow and attestation fails closed.

bounded_discriminator.scope: function-level reconstruction of the current selector and obvious-broad-policy logic
bounded_discriminator.note: This supports the repaired mechanism only. It is not exact-branch pytest, Kubernetes API admission, Kata/microVM, CNI enforcement, final OCI runtime or whole-product evidence.
